idCitation.resTitle: Millcreek buildings and canopy cover zones (2023 lidar), planning estimate

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Building footprints with lidar roof heights, and tree canopy cover by ownership zone, for Millcreek, Utah, from 2023 lidar. Unvalidated planning estimate; not surveyed or field-verified.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
Planning estimate. This layer is an unvalidated estimate derived from lidar by City of Millcreek GIS. It has not been surveyed, engineered or checked in the field. Use it for planning, screening and display, not for legal, engineering, property-boundary, permitting or code-compliance decisions.

What it shows

Two layers for Millcreek, Utah:

  • Buildings (22,042 polygons): Salt Lake County's building footprints inside or crossing the city limits, each with roof-height statistics measured from the 2023 lidar. 21,562 footprints have a height; 480 have no lidar roof inside them and their height fields are empty (possible reasons include buildings demolished since the County drew them, very small structures and roofs hidden under trees).
  • Canopy cover zones (13 polygons): the share of the ground covered by tree canopy at least 2 m tall, for the whole city and for groups of land by ownership (private, public and its owner groups, uncertain owner, and land outside every parcel). Citywide canopy cover is 25.59% of the observed area (2,103 acres).

Typical uses: a citywide look at building heights and massing, finding tall or unusual buildings for review, canopy goals and comparisons between ownership groups. Heights are roof minus ground, not building heights as a building code defines them.

How it was made

  • Roofs. Every lidar point was classified three independent ways: this project's own first classification, the IGN FRACTAL model, and Esri's pretrained building model. A point counts as roof when at least two of the three call it building. The roof surface is the highest first or single return in each 0.5 m cell from those points.
  • Ground. The bare-earth terrain is interpolated at 0.5 m from the ground-classified returns (under a building it is interpolated from the ground around it).
  • Heights. For every 0.5 m cell whose centre lies inside a footprint (and inside the city), roof elevation minus terrain elevation. A footprint's median (HEIGHT_P50_M), 95th percentile and maximum are taken over the cells that have both a roof and terrain value. Footprint shapes and County attributes are unchanged.
  • Canopy. A canopy height model at 0.5 m: vegetation returns minus terrain, with roofs masked out. Canopy is any observed cell at least 2 m above the ground. Cover for a zone is canopy cells as a share of the zone's observed cells, counted by cell centres.
  • Zones. From the City's parcel layer: parcels grouped by owner with fixed rules (named public agencies, schools, housing authorities and districts are public; everyone else, including utilities, churches and nonprofits, is private; missing or mixed owners are uncertain), dissolved by group and clipped to the city. "No parcel" is the city outside every parcel, mostly streets and other rights-of-way. Zones overlap: the whole-city zone contains all the others and the public owner groups sit inside "Public / government parcels", so do not add areas across rows.

Accuracy and checks

  • Roof classification, against 1,217 hand-labelled roof and non-roof parts on one 1 km tile (a deliberately hard sample, not a citywide accuracy): 92.8% of roofs found; 2.8% of non-roof parts called roof.
  • Vegetation classification, same tile: 95.9% of tree parts called vegetation; 10.7% of non-vegetation parts called vegetation; shrubs 76.5%.
  • Roof support. 2,380 footprints have a lidar roof on less than 80% of their area (LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT). Their heights are less reliable: lower roofs, porches and carports are often the part missed. Of the footprints with at least 95% support, the 3D blocks built from these heights are within 1 m of the median roof for all but 13 of 14,229.
  • Canopy coverage. About 99.4% of every zone is observed by the lidar; the low and high bounds in the layer show how far the unobserved cells could move each figure (about half a point at most).
  • Copies. Every value and every footprint shape was checked against the source library before upload (0 rows differ), and the projection to Web Mercator was checked vertex by vertex (all within 0.07 mm of Esri's own projection with the ITRF08 transformation).
  • None of these figures is a field validation. No building height has been compared with a survey or a plan set.

Limits

  • Heights are roof-minus-terrain estimates, not code-defined building heights (which are measured to a defined point of the roof from a defined grade). Chimneys, rooftop equipment, parapets and branches over a roof raise the maximum; the median is the safest single figure.
  • Footprints are the County's. A footprint can hold several buildings, a building can have several footprints, and buildings built or demolished since the County drew them show up as missing or empty roofs. 22,042 is a count of footprint records, not of buildings.
  • Many County fields are empty in this snapshot (BLDGHEIGHT, SOURCE, most ADDRESS and BuiltYear values). They are carried unchanged so the layer joins back to the County's.
  • Canopy at 2 m includes tall shrubs and excludes lower plants. Leaf-off trees in early November may be under-counted where few returns came back from bare branches.
  • Do not use Shape__Area or Shape__Length for measurement. ArcGIS Online computes them in Web Mercator, which inflates areas here by about 1.74 times and lengths by about 1.32 times. Use FOOTPRINT_M2 and ZONE_ACRES, which were computed in UTM before upload.

Coordinates and heights. Built in NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 12N (EPSG 6341), metres, and taken to WGS84 / Web Mercator for ArcGIS Online with the transformation WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011. Every layer in the Millcreek LiDAR 2023 set uses this same transformation, so the layers line up with each other and with Esri's basemaps to a few centimetres; without it they would sit about 1.2 m apart. Elevations are NAVD88 (Geoid18) in metres; heights are metres above the lidar bare-earth terrain.

Lidar source. The 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24, USGS 3D Elevation Program), flown on October 7, November 2 and November 4, 2023. Quality level 1 means at least 8 pulses per square metre and a vertical accuracy (RMSEz) of 10 cm or better on open, non-vegetated ground under the USGS specification; the vendor's own accuracy report for this project has not been reviewed for these products. For these products the building and vegetation classes of the points were refined; the ground class was not changed. All products are gridded at 0.5 m.

Data dictionary: buildings (layer 0)

Field descriptions below are also stored on the layer's fields (Data tab, and field information in Map Viewer).

Field Alias Type Units Description
OBJECTID OBJECTID OID Row number assigned by ArcGIS Online. Not stable if the layer is republished; do not use it as a key. Use SOURCE_OID to join to the County footprints or to the 3D buildings layer.
SOURCE_ID County building ID String (40) Salt Lake County's OBJECTID for this footprint, as text (the same number as SOURCE_OID). Unique and never empty. From the County's public Building Footprints service, downloaded October 19, 2026.
SOURCE_OID SOURCE_OID Integer Salt Lake County's OBJECTID for this footprint, as a number (719,802 to 1,077,673). Unique and never empty. The join key to the County footprints and to the Millcreek 3D buildings scene layer, which carries the same field.
ADDRESS Address String (75) County address attribute, carried unchanged. Empty for 21,960 of 22,042 footprints in this snapshot; not a complete address list.
CITY CITY String (35) County city attribute, carried unchanged: MILLCREEK (21,945), UNINCORPORATED (73), SALT LAKE CITY (19), MURRAY (4), empty (1). Footprints were selected by their position inside the Millcreek boundary, not by this field.
COUNTY COUNTY String (20) County attribute, carried unchanged: SALT LAKE COUNTY (22,038), SALT LAKE (3), empty (1).
PARCEL_ID Parcel ID String (25) County parcel number recorded on the footprint, carried unchanged. Empty for 103 footprints. Not checked against the current parcel layer.
SOURCE SOURCE String (30) County attribute, carried unchanged. Empty for every footprint in this snapshot.
BuildType Building type String (50) County building-type attribute, carried unchanged; free text, not documented by the County. Empty for 21,879. Values seen: Appartments [sic] 56, Residential 42, Commercial 33, Government 5, numeric codes (111, 112, 114, 142, 566, 954, 115 10-19) and "?".
Carto Carto SmallInteger County attribute, carried unchanged; its meaning is not documented by the County. Empty for 21,906; values 1 (98), 6 (33) and 2 (5).
JURISDICTION JURISDICTION String (50) County jurisdiction attribute, carried unchanged: Millcreek (20,266), empty (1,677), Unincorporated SLCo (73), Salt Lake (20), MILLCREEK CITY (5), MURRAY (1).
BLDGHEIGHT County height field Double The County's own building-height field, carried unchanged. Empty for every footprint in this snapshot and not used in any calculation. For a height, use HEIGHT_P50_M or HEIGHT_P50_FT.
BuiltYear Year built SmallInteger year County year-built attribute, carried unchanged. Present for only 21 footprints (1956 to 2021); empty otherwise.
FOOTPRINT_M2 Footprint area (m2) Double square metres True ground area of the whole footprint polygon, computed in NAD83(2011) / UTM 12N before upload (0.10 to 19,324.6 m2). Use this for area, not Shape__Area. Multiply by 10.7639 for square feet.
AOI_PCT AOI_PCT Double percent Share of the footprint's area inside the Millcreek city limits, 0 to 100. Under 100 for the 27 footprints that cross the boundary (PARTIAL_AOI = 1); their statistics use only the part inside.
ROOF_COV_PCT Roof support (% of footprint cells) Double percent Roof support: ROOF_CELLS as a percentage of GRID_CELLS, 0 to 100. The share of the footprint's 0.5 m cells that have a lidar roof (2 of 3 classifiers agree) and terrain. Under 80 sets LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT. A review indicator, not an accuracy. Empty for the 3 footprints with no cell centre.
ROOF_Z50_M Median roof elevation (m, NAVD88) Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Median elevation of the lidar roof cells in the footprint, in metres above the NAVD88 datum (Geoid18), 1,297.6 to 1,764.2. Empty for the 480 footprints with no roof cell.
GROUND_Z50_M Median ground elevation (m, NAVD88) Double metres, NAVD88 (Geoid18) Median bare-earth terrain elevation in the same cells as the roof statistics, in metres NAVD88 (Geoid18), 1,294.4 to 1,757.9. Under a building the terrain is interpolated from the ground around it. Empty for the 480 footprints with no roof cell.
HEIGHT_P50_M Median roof height (m) Double metres Main height estimate: the median of roof elevation minus terrain over the footprint's cells with both values, in metres (0.80 to 37.06). Roof minus ground, not a code-defined building height. Empty for the 480 footprints with no roof cell. Feet: HEIGHT_P50_FT.
HEIGHT_P95_M 95th percentile roof height (m) Double metres 95th percentile of roof minus terrain over the same cells, in metres (0.80 to 42.22): close to the highest roof parts but not set by one stray cell. Empty for the 480 footprints with no roof cell. Feet: HEIGHT_P95_FT.
HEIGHT_MAX_M Maximum roof height (m) Double metres Highest single cell of roof minus terrain, in metres (0.80 to 43.32). Can be a chimney, antenna, rooftop unit, overhanging branch or noise; use with care. Empty for the 480 footprints with no roof cell.
GRID_CELLS GRID_CELLS Integer cells of 0.25 m2 Number of 0.5 m grid cells (0.25 m2 each) whose centres fall inside the part of the footprint within the city (0 to 77,312). 0 means a sliver with no cell centre (NO_CELL_CENTERS).
ROOF_CELLS ROOF_CELLS Integer cells of 0.25 m2 Number of those cells with both a lidar roof value and a terrain value; the cells the height statistics use (0 to 68,926). 0 means no roof support (NO_ROOF_SUPPORT).
NEG_H_CELLS Cells with roof below terrain Integer cells of 0.25 m2 Number of cells whose roof is below the terrain (negative height), 0 to 9. They are kept in the statistics; any sets NEGATIVE_HEIGHT (35 footprints).
PARTIAL_AOI PARTIAL_AOI Integer 1 if the footprint extends outside the Millcreek city limits (27 footprints), otherwise 0. Statistics use only the part inside the city.
HEIGHT_STATUS Height flags String (160) Review flags, separated by semicolons. Always UNVALIDATED, plus any of: LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT (roof on under 80% of cells, 2,380), NO_ROOF_SUPPORT (no roof cell, 477), NEGATIVE_HEIGHT (35), PARTIAL_AOI (crosses city limit, 27), GEOMETRY_REPAIRED (5), NO_CELL_CENTERS (3). Example: UNVALIDATED;LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT.
HEIGHT_P50_FT Median roof height (ft) Double feet HEIGHT_P50_M in feet (multiplied by 3.280839895, rounded to 0.01 ft; 2.64 to 121.60). Empty where HEIGHT_P50_M is empty. Roof minus ground, not a code-defined building height.
HEIGHT_P95_FT 95th percentile roof height (ft) Double feet HEIGHT_P95_M in feet (multiplied by 3.280839895, rounded to 0.01 ft; 2.64 to 138.52). Empty where HEIGHT_P95_M is empty.
Shape__Area Shape__Area Double Web Mercator square metres Polygon area computed by ArcGIS Online in Web Mercator. Not a true area: about 1.74 times too large at Millcreek's latitude. Use FOOTPRINT_M2.
Shape__Length Shape__Length Double Web Mercator metres Perimeter computed by ArcGIS Online in Web Mercator. Not a true length: about 1.32 times too long at Millcreek's latitude.

HEIGHT_STATUS flags

Every footprint carries UNVALIDATED; the other flags are added, separated by semicolons, when they apply (for example UNVALIDATED;LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT).

Flag Footprints Meaning
UNVALIDATED 22,042 Every record: no height has been checked against a survey.
LOW_ROOF_SUPPORT 2,380 Lidar roof on less than 80% of the footprint's cells (ROOF_COV_PCT under 80). A review flag, not an accuracy threshold.
NO_ROOF_SUPPORT 477 No cell in the footprint has a lidar roof; height fields are empty. Often a demolished, very small or tree-covered building.
NEGATIVE_HEIGHT 35 At least one cell has its roof below the terrain (NEG_H_CELLS above 0). Those cells are kept; no footprint has a negative median.
PARTIAL_AOI 27 The footprint crosses the city limit; statistics use only the part inside (AOI_PCT under 100).
GEOMETRY_REPAIRED 5 The County polygon was invalid and was repaired (area change under 0.000000001 m2).
NO_CELL_CENTERS 3 A sliver inside the city that holds no 0.5 m cell centre; no statistics.

Data dictionary: canopy cover zones (layer 1)

Field Alias Type Units Description
OBJECTID OBJECTID OID Row number assigned by ArcGIS Online; use ZONE_ID as the key.
ZONE_ID ZONE_ID String (80) Zone code: CITY (whole city); OWNERSHIP:PRIVATE, OWNERSHIP:PUBLIC_GOVERNMENT, OWNERSHIP:UNKNOWN_OWNER, OWNERSHIP:NO_PARCEL (land outside every parcel); PUBLIC:OWNER_GROUP for each public owner group (for example PUBLIC:SALT_LAKE_COUNTY). Zones overlap: CITY holds all others and the PUBLIC zones sit inside OWNERSHIP:PUBLIC_GOVERNMENT.
ZONE_NAME Zone String (60) Readable zone name for legends and pop-ups, one per ZONE_ID (for example "Private parcels", "No parcel (streets, rights-of-way)").
ZONE_ACRES Zone area (acres) Double acres True area of the zone polygon in acres (square metres / 4,046.8564224), computed in NAD83(2011) / UTM 12N, rounded to 0.1 acre. Do not add across rows: zones overlap.
OBSERVED_PCT Lidar coverage (% observed) Double percent Share of the zone's 0.5 m cells (by cell centre) where the lidar could tell whether canopy is present, 99.06 to 99.76. The rest are unobserved and are left out of CANOPY_PCT.
CANOPY_PCT Canopy cover (% of observed area) Double percent Tree canopy cover: cells with vegetation at least 2 m above the ground as a percentage of the zone's observed cells. The figure to quote (city 25.59). Unvalidated planning estimate from 2023 lidar.
CANOPY_LOW_PCT Canopy cover, low bound (%) Double percent Canopy as a percentage of all the zone's cells, counting every unobserved cell as no canopy. With CANOPY_HIGH_PCT it bounds what the unobserved cells could do to the figure. A coverage bound, not a statistical confidence interval.
CANOPY_HIGH_PCT Canopy cover, high bound (%) Double percent Canopy as a percentage of all the zone's cells, counting every unobserved cell as canopy. A coverage bound, not a statistical confidence interval.
CANOPY_ACRES Canopy (acres) Double acres Area of canopy at least 2 m tall in the zone: canopy cells times 0.25 m2, in acres, rounded to 0.1 acre (city 2,103.1). Counts observed canopy only.
CANOPY_PCT_OCT19 Canopy cover, October 19 (%) Double percent The same measure from the October 19, 2026 canopy, built from an earlier single classification of the same lidar. For comparison only: the current figures are 0.2 to 1.7 points lower, mostly because roof edges and structures left the canopy.
Shape__Area Shape__Area Double Web Mercator square metres Polygon area computed by ArcGIS Online in Web Mercator; about 1.74 times the true area here. Use ZONE_ACRES.
Shape__Length Shape__Length Double Web Mercator metres Perimeter computed by ArcGIS Online in Web Mercator; about 1.32 times the true length here.

The Millcreek LiDAR 2023 set. Eight layers from the same lidar and the same processing: buildings and canopy cover zones (feature layer), 3D buildings (scene layer), bare-earth terrain (elevation layer), hillshade (tile layer), slope classes, 2 m contours, treetops and tree crowns (vector tile layers). They share one coordinate transformation and one terrain, so they can be stacked in one map or scene.

Questions or corrections: City of Millcreek GIS. The processing records (scripts, checks and run logs) are kept by City of Millcreek GIS.
dataIdInfo.idCredit: City of Millcreek GIS. Lidar: 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP, project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24). Building footprints: Salt Lake County Assessor and Surveyor (downloaded October 19, 2026). Parcels: City of Millcreek parcel layer (2025 tax year).

Consts.useLimit:
These data are unvalidated planning estimates produced by City of Millcreek GIS from 2023 lidar. They are not surveyed, engineered or field-verified, and must not be used to determine property boundaries or ownership, building or site design, engineering, flood or drainage design, code compliance (including building height), or any legal or regulatory determination. They are provided as is, without warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for any purpose; check conditions on the ground before relying on them. Credit "City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP)" when you use or show them.

Salt Lake County data. The building footprints and their County attributes come from Salt Lake County (Assessor and Surveyor). The County's own terms apply to them: the County states that its footprints are not field verified, are for general reference only, and are not intended to determine property ownership, final building and site design or jurisdictional boundaries, or to replace a certified topographical or boundary survey or any other legal document.

Parcels. Ownership groups come from the City of Millcreek parcel layer (2025 tax-year snapshot, read October 8, 2026). A tax year is not an ownership effective date, and the grouping of owners into private, public and uncertain is the City's own rule set for this analysis, not a legal finding of ownership.

dataLineage.statement: County building footprints (Salt Lake County, downloaded 2026-10-19) summarised against 0.5 m lidar roof and bare-earth rasters from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar: roof points where 2 of 3 independent classifications agree, heights as roof minus terrain per cell. Canopy cover from a 0.5 m canopy height model (canopy at least 2 m) summarised over ownership zones from the City parcel layer (2025 tax year). Projected to Web Mercator with WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011 and checked against the source library. Lidar flown 2023-10-07 to 2023-11-04 (USGS project UT_2023SaltLakeCo_C24). Unvalidated planning estimate; not surveyed or field-verified.
